Presenting the full video song "Humraah" from the movie Malang. This latest track is sung by Sachet Tandon, music is by The Fusion Project and lyrics are penned by Kunaal Vermaa.
Gulshan Kumar and T-Series present a Luv Films production, from Mohit Suri’s multi-starrer thrilling love story Malang- Unleash The Madness starring Aditya Roy Kapur, Disha Patani, Anil Kapoor and Kunal Kemmu.
Written by Aseem Arorra, the film is produced by Bhushan Kumar, Krishan Kumar, Luv Ranjan, Ankur Garg, and Jay Shewakramani.
MALANG In the Cinemas Now !!
